core_change_summary.description: Migrated 12 package.json lint:tsc scripts from 'tsc --noEmit' to 'tsgo --noEmit', added @typescript/native-preview devDependency, removed baseUrl from 3 tsconfig.json files, and fixed TypeScript errors in jobs package for tsgo compatibility.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The remaining changed files are the 12 package.json files updated with the new lint:tsc script, plus a CI workflow tweak.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: Replaced 'tsc --noEmit' with 'tsgo --noEmit' in 12 packages, installed @typescript/native-preview, removed baseUrl from 3 tsconfig.json files.
Second commit: Fixed TypeScript errors in jobs package for tsgo compatibility, converting metadata and vector to JSON strings.
Third commit: Added Supabase container cleanup to CI workflow to prevent port conflicts.
